description: Promotion gate engine and artifact continuity audit. Reads EXOCHRONOS-style CSV matrices and evaluates rows for promotion readiness using a strict set of required signal fields. Also validates artifact SHA-256 integrity from JSONL seal ledgers and replays JSONL event ledgers with hash-chain verification.
function: Promotion evaluation, SEAL continuity validation, JSONL ledger replay

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to promotion matrix CSV for read_matrix_csv

inputs.name: paths
inputs.description: One or more CSV matrix file paths for evaluate_promotion

inputs.name: row
inputs.description: SEAL ledger record dict for validate_seal_record

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Filesystem root for resolving artifact paths in seal validation

inputs.name: ledger_path
inputs.description: Path to JSONL seal ledger for validate_seal_ledger

inputs.name: path_jsonl
inputs.description: Path to JSONL event ledger for replay_jsonl_ledger

outputs.name: read_matrix_csv
outputs.description: List of row dicts from promotion matrix CSV

outputs.name: evaluate_promotion
outputs.description: Promotion verdict dict with candidates, blockers, and reason counts

outputs.name: validate_seal_record
outputs.description: Seal record validation result with valid flag and errors list

outputs.name: validate_seal_ledger
outputs.description: Full ledger validation report with pass/fail counts

outputs.name: replay_jsonl_ledger
outputs.description: Ledger replay result with status PASS or FAIL and event count

public_api.name: read_matrix_csv
public_api.description: Read a promotion matrix CSV into a list of row dicts.

public_api.name: evaluate_promotion
public_api.description: Evaluate promotion candidates across one or more CSV matrix files. Returns verdict dict with candidates, blockers, and reason counts.

public_api.name: validate_seal_record
public_api.signature: validate_seal_record(row: Dict, root: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Validate one SEAL continuity ledger record against the filesystem.

public_api.name: validate_seal_ledger
public_api.signature: validate_seal_ledger(ledger_path: Path, root: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Validate an entire SEAL continuity JSONL ledger by re-checking SHA-256 and file size against the filesystem.

public_api.name: replay_jsonl_ledger
public_api.description: Replay a JSONL event ledger, verifying hash-parent chain and monotonic event_id. Returns status PASS or FAIL with reason.
